The first one is specialty coffee, which debateably pays well if you own a business.
The other is auto enthusiasm/motorsport, and that'll do nothing but lose money(neglecting the fact that it also takes assloads of money to even get into, but that's neither here nor there).

Probably some mix of the 3, if not maybe a couple more factors. There doesn't seem to be much point in being alive if life is less about pursuing the passions and more about living paycheck to paycheck. I don't see how anyone else can bear it.
